title: Suspension and Reactivation Policy, VPS and Dedicated Servers
content:
## Policy

A server in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range that is unpaid the tier's grace period in calendar days after its term end, or whose abuse report is still open the tier's abuse response time in elapsed hours after it was forwarded, is suspended. A server suspended for non-payment may be reactivated only on or before the suspension date plus the tier's retention period in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the suspension date, counting the next day as day 1, and the last day is included, after which the disks are wiped. Reactivation after non-payment requires the renewal plus the tier's reactivation fee, and a server suspended for abuse is reactivated without a fee once the report is resolved.

## The two causes of suspension

| Cause recorded on the holding | What brings it about | What reactivation requires |
|---|---|---|
| Non-payment | The server is still unpaid the grace period in calendar days after its term end | The renewal plus the reactivation fee, on or before the last day of the retention window |
| Abuse | An abuse report about the server is still open the abuse response time in elapsed hours after it was forwarded to the customer | The report is resolved; no fee |

An abuse report covers spam, malware, attack traffic or copyright complaints, and is recorded as open or resolved. The reactivation fee, where due, is billed as its own reactivation fee line.

## The retention window after a non-payment suspension

The clock starts from the suspension date on the server's holding record. The day after the suspension date is day 1, and the last day of the window is the suspension date plus the tier's retention period in calendar days. Reactivation on that last day is inside the window. After it the disks are wiped and the server is terminated; a terminated server is not reactivated.

**Hypothetical boundary cases.** The 9-day retention period below is an invented input, not a Harborline figure. A server suspended for non-payment on 3 September has day 1 on 4 September and its last day on 12 September.

| Reactivation requested on | Inside the window |
|---|---|
| 12 September (the last day) | Yes |
| 13 September (the day after) | No; the disks are wiped after 12 September |

## Abuse timing, hypothetical

With a hypothetical response time of 30 elapsed hours, a report forwarded at 09:00 on one day and still open at 15:00 on the following day has reached 30 elapsed hours, and the server is suspended. Once that report is resolved, the server is reactivated without a fee.

On reactivation the suspension date is cleared and the server is active again.
